description: This file defines the class SugarCacheRedis, which implements a Redis backend for the SugarCache system in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for connecting to a Redis server, caching data, retrieving, clearing, and resetting cache entries, and handling configuration settings for Redis.

classes.name: SugarCacheRedis
classes.description: A class that provides Redis caching functionalities for SuiteCRM, extending the abstract SugarCache class.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the Redis backend can be used by checking PHP Redis extension, configuration, and connection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: _getRedisObject
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Redis connection object, setting host and port from configuration.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Serializes and stores a value in Redis cache with expiration.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves and unserializes a cached value from Redis.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a specific cache entry from Redis.

methods.name: _fixKeyName
methods.description: Replaces spaces with underscores in cache keys to ensure proper key formatting in Redis.
